newsitem.title: USA: O'Sullivan sees Q3 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: O'Sullivan sees Q3 below estimates.

text.p: O'Sullivan Corp said Thursday that third quarter earnings will be down sharply from the $0.17 per share reported in the third quarter of 1995.

The company attributed the outlook to losses at its subsidiary, Melnor Inc, and production problems at its plastics division. It said contamination of a key raw material caused processing problems at the division.

The company said it hopes to resolve a cost-recovery claim with the supplier of the raw material by year-end, and the plastics division should return to normal profitability by the end of the fourth quarter.
The company said losses at its Melnor subsidiary resulted from production quality problems with the new "Mellennia" product line and a poor sales season.

Separately, the company said it is continuing to purchase its stock under a previously approved stock repurchase program. The company said it has repurchased about 540,000 shares out of an authorized amount of 800,000 shares.
O'Sullivan Corp provides premium vinyl coverstock for automotive, medical and office supply products, and its subsidiary, Melnor Inc, provides lawn and garden watering products.
